claim_audit.claim: 11.7% refers to YoY growth in >$20 m client accounts, not attrition.
claim_audit.assessment: The original LTM attrition KPI was a context error and has been removed.

claim_audit.assessment: Normalized tax can improve the earnings interpretation, but must not be mixed with a different profit-attribution basis.

claim_audit.claim: Capital-return policy is 85%+of FCF.

claim_audit.claim: Management expects full FCNR dilution in Q3 and potential recovery from Q4.
claim_audit.assessment: This is a conditional path under current rate assumptions, not a guaranteed fixed quarterly margin floor.

claim_audit.claim: NNPA was 0.30%, CET1 16.01%, and contingency provisions ₹13,100 crore.
claim_audit.assessment: Current resilience is supported, but low present losses do not measure the future risk of rapid loan growth.

claim_audit.assessment: These are gross flows, not the same as net NPA additions or the P&L provision charge.

claim_audit.claim: Business-banking growth was 33.8% and corporate growth 30.6%.
claim_audit.assessment: New-vintage seasoning matters; high growth in these segments is not automatically equivalent to lower-risk growth.

claim_audit.assessment: A risk-calibrated operating approach is not a specific numerical promise for a graded delivery ledger.
